name: Jar of Spell Stealing
body:
Aura faint abjuration; CL 6th; Slot -; Price 33 gp (0-level), 75 gp (1st-level), 450 gp (2nd-level), 1,125 gp (3rd-level), 2,100 gp (4th-level), 3,375 gp (5th-level), 4,950 gp (6th-level), 6,825 gp (7th-level), 9,000 gp (8th-level), 11,475 gp (9th-level); Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

This small earthenware jar bears runes upon its surface.

If held in one hand, the user can steal a spell being cast within 10 feet as an immediate action. When the jar is activated (the open part of the jar pointed at the target), the caster must make a concentration check (DC 20 + the spell level). If the concentration check fails, the spell fails and is sealed within the jar. A runed, earthenware lid seals the top. The jar can contain a spell of equal level or lower than the spell level listed for the jar. If the target spellcaster succeeds on their concentration check, the attempt to steal a spell is lost but the jar is still usable.

A stored spell can be used in two ways. In both cases the jar itself disintegrates and is no longer usable.

By opening the jar’s lid the spell is cast upon the holder or with the holder as the center of the radius of the effect.
By throwing the jar, the thrower may make a ranged touch attack as if throwing an alchemical item. The target or square hit by the jar is the target of the spell or the center of the spell’s radius.

Jars of sealing with spells stored within already can be found and or sold by general merchants.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item, dispel magic; Special The caster level must be at least double the spell level rating of the jar

Price 17 gp (0-level), 38 gp (1st-level), 225 gp (2nd-level), 563 gp (3rd-level), 1,050 gp (4th-level), 1,688 gp (5th-level), 2,475 gp (6th-level), 3,413 gp (7th-level), 4,500 gp (8th-level), 5,738 gp (9th-level)
